page: OVHcloud c2-120-flex is a compute-focused instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by a dedicated 32-core x86_64 Intel Haswell processor clocked at 3.0 GHz, providing one thread per physical core without simultaneous multithreading. It provides 120.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.75 GB per core. The hardware profile includes a compact 50 GB local SSD boot disk and a 10 Gbps baseline network connection. The platform contains no dedicated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent multi-threaded computational capabilities across dedicated cores. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 256.45 GB/sec, placing it in the top quartile of tested configurations. General compute benchmarks reflect standard Haswell execution, recording 10,744.0 in Geekbench multi-core and 40,291.93 in PassMark CPU. Supported instructions include AVX, AES, BMI2, and FMA, although newer instruction extensions such as AVX-512 and AMX are absent.

Memory bandwidth benchmarks register 102.44 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 28.7 GB/sec for writes. Workload tests show 43.39 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a static web serving throughput of 32.52 GB/sec. Large language model inference tasks show average prompt processing throughput but exhibit reduced text generation rates, reaching 35.84 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model and 6.59 tokens per second on a 7B parameter model.

The 1:1 physical core allocation eliminates noisy neighbor CPU thread contention, delivering reliable execution for steady processing demands. Given the combination of 32 dedicated cores, 120 GB memory, and a modest 50 GB local SSD, the instance is suitable for parallel batch jobs, multi-threaded software compilation, web service tiers, and microservices where extensive local disk capacity is not required.
description: OVHcloud c2-120-flex is a compute-focused cloud server based on the KVM hypervisor, featuring 32 dedicated physical cores of an x86_64 Intel Haswell processor operating at 3.0 GHz without simultaneous multithreading. The platform integrates 120.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core, alongside 50 GB of local SSD storage and a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. In benchmark evaluations, the dedicated architecture delivers strong parallel execution, highlighted by a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 256.45 GB/sec. General compute metrics, including Geekbench and PassMark scores, remain consistent with middle-tier multi-core profiles. Because it lacks hardware GPU acceleration and newer AVX-512 extensions, LLM text generation is comparatively limited. With dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory, the instance is suitable for CPU-bound multi-threaded processing, software compilation pipelines, web serving, and distributed batch computing workloads requiring consistent per-core execution.
